mapper.select: SELECT id, name, nickname, email, password_hash, image_url, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, nickname, email, password_hash, image_url, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, nickname, email, password_hash, image_url, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users WHERE nickname = #{nickname} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (name, nickname, email, password_hash, image_url, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{imageUrl}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
